page.notes: Marginal ink blot over the text near the line "cap. adversus Anabapt." and the line "dant". The word "bent" at the start of the page is cut off and uncertain. Word "Thessalonicensibus" is a guess at the printed "Thesibus" and is uncertain. The final word "quod" is the catchword. Several lines near the bottom are partly obscured by the blot.
